title: Carbon Fiber PETG 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Malachite Green
body_html:
• Recommend printing temperature 240℃-270℃, build platform 75℃-90℃; 1st to 3rd layer, turn off cooling fan, If your 3D printer is Bambu P1P or X1, we recommend the nozzle temperature above 260 degrees. 
  •  Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (65 °C, 8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 2. Do not use conventional brass nozzles! As the filament contains real carbon fibers, you have to use wear-resistant steel nozzles (≥ 0.4 mm; 0.6 mm is better). 3. To get stronger Z-adhesion, please set a higher infill density and use an enclosed printer; lower the fan percentage to avoid overcooling. 4. Containing 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch (NOT carbon fiber powder). Be sure to wear protective equipment when you cut, sand, grind, or saw something made with CF/GF filaments, as carbon fiber dust will be created!
  • Very easy to print with BAMBU FDM 3D printer, almost no warping. Lightweight and durable, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength. It is an ideal material for drone parts, racing models, and various functional parts.
  • TINMORRY PETG-CF is a composite material consisting of PETG and 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch. The new exclusive formula greatly improved printing quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to traditional PETG, and it also has a very good Z-adhesion.
  • Compatibility and High-Speed Printing: Supports high-speed 3D printing and can print at a speed of 300 mm/s, 3-5 times faster than other brands of Petg-CF filament. Compatible with BAMBU LAB, Creality K1C, QIDI MAX3, FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M, Prusa MK4, VORON, and AnkerMake M5C FDM 3D Printer. If your printer is from any other brand, please contact us to get the filament profile and technical support before use.
  • Please note: 1. The same color of PETG-CF has slightly different effects (Shiny or Matt) on different print models. 2. Different resolutions and devices may result in slightly different color displays!

title: Marble PLA 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Granite
body_html:
• Printing Tips : Recommended print temp 200-220°C, bed temp 60-70°C, printing speed under 300 mm/s. Nozzle size ≥0.4 mm; brass and hardened-steel nozzles are both compatible, no special nozzle-material requirements.
  • Realistic Marble-Like Look: Produces authentic matte stone-like finish with random veining, effectively concealing layer lines for premium decorative prints. Ideal for sculptures, vases & architectural ornaments; for decorative use only, not for load-bearing functional parts.
  • Easy-to-Print Performance: Marble PLA offers consistent extrusion and lowers nozzle-clog risk for FDM printers. Low-shrink formula minimizes cooling warping. Filament maintains ±0.03 mm diameter tolerance to deliver steady material flow for clean marble-style decorative prints.
  • Tangle-Less & Neatly Wound: Every spool gets manual inspection and precise winding to avoid filament tangling and knots. Uniform tight winding stops snags, reduces unexpected print failures and mid-job stops, delivering smooth, steady feeding for long-run FDM 3D printing.
  • Vacuum-Sealed Spool Design&Wide Compatibility: Vacuum-sealed spool keeps filament dry for stable out-of-box printing, blocking moisture to protect quality. TINMORRY filament fits most 1.75 mm FDM printers. Contact support for filament profiles or download matching parameter files from our GitHub page.

It achieves zero stringing, no nozzle clogs, and no burrs, enabling smooth, one-touch printing even for beginners. This significantly reduces material waste and print failure rates.
  • 【High-Speed Printing】 Supports high-speed printing up to 300mm/s, which is 3-5 times faster than other brands' PLA filaments. Even at high speeds, it easily produces high-quality prints with uniform surfaces.
  • 【Tips】 1. Recommended printing temperature: 195-225°C, build platform temperature: 55-65°C. 2. If the indoor temperature is too low, it is recommended to increase the temperature of the hotbed or use glue to prevent warping.
  • 【Low shrinkage rate achieves high-precision printed models】 TINMORRY's newly formulated PLA effectively prevents dimensional errors, layer separation, and edge curling, minimizing warping and deformation during printing. The filament diameter is uniform with no variation, maintaining stable dimensional accuracy at 1.75±0.03mm. Printed models achieve sharp edges, vivid details, and smooth surfaces without layer lines, eliminating the need for secondary polishing.
  • 【Wide Compatibility】 TINMORRY Rapid PLA filament is compatible with most 1.75mm FDM 3D printers on the market and perfectly fits Bambu Lab / Creality K1, K2 / QIDI/FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M / Prusa MK4 / ANYCUBIC Kobra / AnkerMake M5 FDM 3D printers, etc. If you have any questions while using TINMORRY filament, please contact us to get the filament profile or download from GitHub.

title: Glass Fiber TPU Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Frosted Light Grey
body_html:
• Printing Tips:Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (70 °C, 8h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed，with Desiccant). 2. Nozzle temperature: 220-250 °C. Bed Temp:40-60 °C, Print Speed: <150mm/s. 3. Recommended to use hardened steel nozzles (>0.4mm,0.6mm is better) instead of ordinary brass nozzles!
  • Glass Fiber Texture,Minimal Layer Lines: The surface of the TINMORRY TPU-GF model is bright and smooth overall, and the scattered Glass fibers make the surface slightly frosted and highly reflective, making the surface of the model evenly shiny and without showing layer lines, which makes the prints more delicate. Besides, TINMORRY TPU-GF is also a good choice for display items, decroations, Garage Kits and other products.
  • Higher Flow, Shorter Time: Glass Fiber TPU filament is specially designed and can be printed at high speeds. At 235 °C nozzle temperature, its maximum printing speed can reach 250 mm/s (common 0.4 mm hardened still nozzle), which is the same as PLA Basic and much higher than generic TPU 95A. Therefore, when printing models with it, the time can be greatly shortened and the efficiency can be greatly improved.
  • Flexible and Tough, Resistant to Impact: TPU-GF has excellent flexibility and elasticity, and can withstand strong impacts without damage. It is suitable for printing models that need to withstand dropping and collision, as well as models that play a buffering and protection role.
  • Cold & Wear-Resistant, Durable: TINMORRY glass fiber TPU 3d printing filament has extraordinary cold resistance and does not become brittle at low temperatures of - 30 °C or so. Therefore, it can be used to print tools to use in outdoor snow and ice environments. In addition, it has outstanding water, oil, grease, and wear resistance and durability, so it can also be used to print shoes, tyres, water pipe seal rings, floor drains, kitchen filters and other items.

title: Glass Fiber PC 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Carter Yellow
body_html:
• Much Stiffer and Warping Resistant: With the reinforcement of glass fiber, TINMORRY PC-GF has significantly higher stiffness and warping resistance than Generic PC, which makes the prints more resistant to deformation during both printing and use.
  • Ultra-high Layer Adhesion: TINMORRY PC-GF can make the prints have ultra-high layer adhesion, which makes up for the shortcoming of most filaments and ensures that the products are not easy to break when subjected to forces in all directions.
  • High-Speed Printing: TINMORRY PC-GF is specially designed and can be printed at high speeds. At 285 °C nozzle temperature, its max printing speed can reach 200 mm/s (common 0.4 mm hardened steel nozzle)
  • Delicate Surface, Engineering Level and Durable: The presence of glass fiber makes the models made of TINMORRY PC-GF look slightly frosted and have invisible layer lines, which makes them delicate, fine and dimensionally accurate. In addition, TINMORRY PC-GF has excellent durability and resistance to oil , grease, water, wear, and heat: HDT reaches 107 °C (0.45 MPa), so it can be used to print aesthetic models and mechanical parts that need to come into contact with hot water, grease and etc.
  • Tips: 1. Recommend Nozzle Temp 275-295℃, Bed Temp: 100-110℃ , Print Speed: <200mm/s. 2. Please use wear-resistant steel nozzles ( 0.6 mm is recommended, 0.4mm Capable) instead of ordinary brass nozzles!  3. Dry before use for the highest print quality (80-90 °C, 6-8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 4.If you have any questions while using TINMORRY filament, please contact us to get filament profile or download from GitHub.

title: 10 Rolls Carbon Fiber PETG Filament, 1 KG 1 Spool, Black
body_html:
• Recommend printing temperature 240℃-270℃, build platform 75℃-90℃; 1st to 3rd layer, turn off cooling fan, If your 3D printer is Bambu P1P or X1, we recommend the nozzle temperature above 260 degrees.
  • Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (65 °C, 8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 2. Do not use conventional brass nozzles! As the filament contains real carbon fibers, you have to use wear-resistant steel nozzles (≥ 0.4 mm; 0.6 mm is better). 3. To get stronger Z-adhesion, please set a higher infill density and use an enclosed printer; lower the fan percentage to avoid overcooling. 4. Containing 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch (NOT carbon fiber powder). Be sure to wear protective equipment when you cut, sand, grind, or saw something made with CF/GF filaments, as carbon fiber dust will be created!
  • Very easy to print with BAMBU FDM 3D printer, almost no warping. Lightweight and durable, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength. It is an ideal material for drone parts, racing models, and various functional parts.

title: Glass Fiber TPU Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Frosted Black
body_html:
• Printing Tips:Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (70 °C, 8h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed，with Desiccant). 2. Nozzle temperature: 220-250 °C. Bed Temp:40-60 °C, Print Speed: <150mm/s. 3. Recommended to use hardened steel nozzles (>0.4mm,0.6mm is better) instead of ordinary brass nozzles!
  • Glass Fiber Texture,Minimal Layer Lines: The surface of the TINMORRY TPU-GF model is bright and smooth overall, and the scattered Glass fibers make the surface slightly frosted and highly reflective, making the surface of the model evenly shiny and without showing layer lines, which makes the prints more delicate. Besides, TINMORRY TPU-GF is also a good choice for display items, decroations, Garage Kits and other products.
  • Higher Flow, Shorter Time: Glass Fiber TPU filament is specially designed and can be printed at high speeds. At 235 °C nozzle temperature, its maximum printing speed can reach 250 mm/s (common 0.4 mm hardened still nozzle), which is the same as PLA Basic and much higher than generic TPU 95A. Therefore, when printing models with it, the time can be greatly shortened and the efficiency can be greatly improved.
  • Flexible and Tough, Resistant to Impact: TPU-GF has excellent flexibility and elasticity, and can withstand strong impacts without damage. It is suitable for printing models that need to withstand dropping and collision, as well as models that play a buffering and protection role.
  • Cold & Wear-Resistant, Durable: TINMORRY glass fiber TPU 3d printing filament has extraordinary cold resistance and does not become brittle at low temperatures of - 30 °C or so. Therefore, it can be used to print tools to use in outdoor snow and ice environments. In addition, it has outstanding water, oil, grease, and wear resistance and durability, so it can also be used to print shoes, tyres, water pipe seal rings, floor drains, kitchen filters and other items.

title: Carbon Fiber PETG 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Dark Grey
body_html:
Recommend printing temperature 240-270, build platform 75℃-90℃; 1st to 3rd layer, turn off cooling fan, If your 3D printer is Bambu P1P or X1, we recommend the nozzle temperature above 260 degrees.

Tip: 1, Dry before Use for the Highest Print Quality. 2, Do not use conventional brass nozzles! As the filament contains real carbon fibres, you have to use wear-resistant steel nozzles (≥ 0.4 mm, 0.6mm is better). BAMBU LAB 3D printers are highly recommended! If your printer is from other brand, please contact us to get filament profile or download from Github.

Very easy to print with BAMBU FDM 3D printer, almost no warping. Lightweight and durable, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile and impact strength. It is an ideal material for drone parts, racing models, and various functional parts.

TINMORRY PETG-CF is a composite material consisting of PETG and carbon fiber. The new formula greatly improved printing quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to traditional PETG.

High-Speed Printing: Supports high speed printing, can print at a speed of 300mm/s, 3-5 times faster than other brand Petg-CF filament. Compatible with BAMBU LAB, Creality K1C, QIDI MAX3, FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M, Prusa MK4, VORON, AnkerMake M5C FDM 3D Printer.

Please note: 1, The same colour of PETG-CF has slightly different effects（Shiny or Matt） on different prints model.  2, Different resolutions and devices may result in slightly different colour displays!

title: Metallic PETG 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Metallic Dark Red
body_html:
【Metallic Dark Red PETG Filament】This Metallic Dark Red PETG filament has a high-grade metallic luster while maintaining almost the same comprehensive performance as ordinary PETG, bringing a high-grade and exquisite smooth metal surface to 3D projects. No metal particle filling. No post-polishing is required, and you can immediately get printed works with a metallic texture. It is suitable for printing various decorations and creative products that require high appearance requirements.

【High-Speed Printing】Support high-speed printing, the printing speed <300mm/s, 3-5 times faster than other brands of PETG filaments. Perfectly compatible with Bambu FDM 3D printers. If you have any questions while using TINMORRY filament, please contact us to get filament profile or download from GitHub.

【Usage Tip】1. Nozzle temperature 230-260 °C, hotbed 75 -90°C. 2. Make sure the first layer gets good adhesion, we recommend switching off the fan from 1st to 3rd layer. 3. It is recommended to dry it before use (65℃--8h) and store it in a dry box during use. 4. The slower the speed, the shinier the surface of the prints stuff.

【High toughness and Good Heat Resistance】 PETG 3D Printer Filament has the advantages of high toughness and low shrinkage and superb layer bonding, It's a good choice when PLA can‘t meet your printing needs and ABS is difficult to print.

【Less prone to tangling and clogging】With a diameter of 1.75±0.03mm, TINMORRY PETG filament is completely mechanically wound and strictly inspected manually to ensure clean winding and easy feeding. The new formula also significantly improves print quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to other brands of PETG.

title: Carbon Fiber PETG-ECO 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 2 KG, Black
body_html:
• Recommend printing temperature 240℃-270℃, build platform 75℃-90℃; 1st to 3rd layer, turn off cooling fan, If your 3D printer is Bambu P1P or X1, we recommend the nozzle temperature above 260 degrees.
  • Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (65 °C, 8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 2. Do not use conventional brass nozzles! As the filament contains real carbon fibers, you have to use wear-resistant steel nozzles (≥ 0.4 mm; 0.6 mm is better). 3. To get stronger Z-adhesion, please set a higher infill density and use an enclosed printer; lower the fan percentage to avoid overcooling. 4. Containing 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch (NOT carbon fiber powder). Be sure to wear protective equipment when you cut, sand, grind, or saw something made with CF/GF filaments, as carbon fiber dust will be created!
  • Very easy to print with BAMBU FDM 3D printer, almost no warping. Lightweight and durable, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength. It is an ideal material for drone parts, racing models, and various functional parts.
  • TINMORRY PETG-CF is a composite material consisting of PETG and 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch. The new exclusive formula greatly improved printing quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to traditional PETG, and it also has a very good Z-adhesion.
  • Compatibility and High-Speed Printing: Supports high-speed 3D printing and can print at a speed of 300 mm/s, 3-5 times faster than other brands of Petg-CF filament. Compatible with BAMBU LAB, Creality K1C, QIDI MAX3, FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M, Prusa MK4, VORON, and AnkerMake M5C FDM 3D Printer. Not compatible with AMS. If your printer is from any other brand, please contact us to get the filament profile and technical support before use.
  • Please note: 1. The same color of PETG-CF has slightly different effects (Shiny or Matt) on different print models. 2. Different resolutions and devices may result in slightly different color displays!

title: Carbon Fiber PETG 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 3 KG, Black
body_html:
• Recommend printing temperature 240℃-270℃, build platform 75℃-90℃; 1st to 3rd layer, turn off cooling fan, If your 3D printer is Bambu P1P or X1, we recommend the nozzle temperature above 260 degrees.
  • Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (65 °C, 8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 2. Do not use conventional brass nozzles! As the filament contains real carbon fibers, you have to use wear-resistant steel nozzles (≥ 0.4 mm; 0.6 mm is better). 3. To get stronger Z-adhesion, please set a higher infill density and use an enclosed printer; lower the fan percentage to avoid overcooling. 4. Containing 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch (NOT carbon fiber powder). Be sure to wear protective equipment when you cut, sand, grind, or saw something made with CF/GF filaments, as carbon fiber dust will be created!
  • Very easy to print with BAMBU FDM 3D printer, almost no warping. Lightweight and durable, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength. It is an ideal material for drone parts, racing models, and various functional parts.
  • TINMORRY PETG-CF is a composite material consisting of PETG and 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch. The new exclusive formula greatly improved printing quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to traditional PETG, and it also has a very good Z-adhesion.
  • Compatibility and High-Speed Printing: Supports high-speed 3D printing and can print at a speed of 300 mm/s, 3-5 times faster than other brands of Petg-CF filament. Compatible with BAMBU LAB, Creality K1C, QIDI MAX3, FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M, Prusa MK4, VORON, and AnkerMake M5C FDM 3D Printer. Not compatible with AMS. title: Metallic PETG 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Metallic Green
body_html:
• 【Metallic Green PETG Filament】This Metallic Green PETG filament has a high-grade metallic luster while maintaining almost the same comprehensive performance as ordinary PETG, bringing a high-grade and exquisite smooth metal surface to 3D projects. No post-polishing is required, and you can immediately get printed works with a metallic texture. It is suitable for printing various decorations and creative products that require high appearance requirements.
  • 【High-Speed Printing】Support high-speed printing, the printing speed can reach 200mm/s, which is 2-3 times faster than other brands of PETG filaments. Perfectly compatible with Bambu FDM 3D printers.
  • 【Usage Tip】1. Nozzle temperature 230-260 °C, hotbed 75 -90°C. 2. Make sure the first layer gets good adhesion, we recommend switching off the fan from 1st to 3rd layer. 3. It is recommended to dry it before use (65℃--8h) and store it in a dry box during use.
  • 【High toughness and Good Heat Resistance】 PETG 3D Printer Filament has the advantages of high toughness and low shrinkage and superb layer bonding, It's a good choice when PLA can‘t meet your printing needs and ABS is difficult to print.
  • 【Less prone to tangling and clogging】With a diameter of 1.75±0.03mm, TINMORRY PETG filament is completely mechanically wound and strictly inspected manually to ensure clean winding and easy feeding. The new formula also significantly improves print quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to other brands of PETG.

• Tips: 1.Since TPU 95A filament is highly sensitive to humidity, it is recommeded to dry before use(Blast Drying Oven: 70℃，8H) and keep sealed after use to achieve optimal printing performance. 2. Nozzle Temperature: 210-240℃, Bed Temperature: 30-50℃, Printing Speed ＜60mm/s. Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant)
  • High Elasticity & Toughness: With a Shore hardness of 95A±2 HA, this filament offers high elasticity and exceptional toughness. It is ideal for creating flexible and bendable prints that require movement, such as phone cases, flexible toys, prosthetics, and other parts that need to stretch or deform.
  • Premium Quality & Durable: TINMORRY TPU 3D printing filament is very easy to use and has excellent adhesion to the hot bed without warping. With consistent dimensional tolerances and smooth extrusion, you can achieve accurate and stable printing size. In addition, with good wear resistance, chemical resistance and UV resistance, our TPU 95A filament is very suitable for various applications, especially those exposed to outdoor or harsh conditions.
  • Vacuum Sealed Packaging: All filaments are completely dried for 24 hours before packaging and packed in sealed vacuum bags with desiccant, which can easily keep the TPU 3D printer filaments in the best storage condition and free from dust or moisture before opening the vacuum sealed package.
  • Wide Compatibility: With a diameter of 1.75 ±0.05mm, our TPU filament is compatible with a wide range of 3D printers, and in particular is perfectly compatible with Bambu FDM 3D printer (AMS not compatible). From customised footwear to medical devices, this 1.75mm TPU 3D printer filament can be flexibly used in a variety of fields.

title: Rapid PETG-Eco 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Black
body_html:
• Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (65 °C, 8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 2. Nozzle temperature 230-260 °C, hotbed 75-90 °C. 3. To make sure the first layer has good adhesion, it is recommended to turn off the cooling fan from the 1st to the 3rd layer.
  • High-Speed Printing: Support high-speed printing up to 300 mm/s, which is 3-5 times faster than other brands of PETG filaments. It's easy to obtain high-quality prints with a uniform surface even at high-speed printing.
  • High toughness and good heat resistance: TINMORRY PETG-Eco 3D Printer Filament has the advantages of high toughness, low shrinkage, and superb layer bonding. It is more robust and durable than PLA for a wider range of applications.
  • Less prone to tangling and clogging: With a diameter of 1.75±0.03mm, TINMORRY PETG-Eco filament is completely mechanically wound and strictly inspected manually to ensure clean winding and easy feeding. The new formula also significantly improves print quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to other brands of PETG.
  • Wide Compatibility: Compatible with most 1.75mm FDM 3D printers on the market. TINMORRY Rapid PETG-eco filament perfectly fits Bambu Lab /Creality K1, K2 / QIDI / FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M / Prusa MK4 /ANYCUBIC Kobra / AnkerMake M5 FDM 3D printers etc. If you have any questions while using TINMORRY filament, please contact us to get filament profile or download from GitHub.

title: Carbon Fiber PETG 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Peacock Green
body_html:
• Recommend printing temperature 240℃-270℃, build platform 75℃-90℃; 1st to 3rd layer, turn off cooling fan, If your 3D printer is Bambu P1P or X1, we recommend the nozzle temperature above 260 degrees.
  • Tips: 1. Dry before use for the highest print quality (65 °C, 8 h). Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant). 2. Do not use conventional brass nozzles! As the filament contains real carbon fibers, you have to use wear-resistant steel nozzles (≥ 0.4 mm; 0.6 mm is better). 3. To get stronger Z-adhesion, please set a higher infill density and use an enclosed printer; lower the fan percentage to avoid overcooling. 4. Containing 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch (NOT carbon fiber powder). Be sure to wear protective equipment when you cut, sand, grind, or saw something made with CF/GF filaments, as carbon fiber dust will be created!
  • Very easy to print with BAMBU FDM 3D printer, almost no warping. Lightweight and durable, suitable for applications requiring torsional, tensile, and impact strength. It is an ideal material for drone parts, racing models, and various functional parts.
  • TINMORRY PETG-CF is a composite material consisting of PETG and 15% professionally processed short-cut carbon fiber masterbatch. The new exclusive formula greatly improved printing quality by reducing nozzle clogging and clumping compared to traditional PETG, and it also has a very good Z-adhesion.
  • Compatibility and High-Speed Printing: Supports high-speed 3D printing and can print at a speed of 300 mm/s, 3-5 times faster than other brands of Petg-CF filament. Compatible with BAMBU LAB, Creality K1C, QIDI MAX3, FLASHFORGE Adventurer 5M, Prusa MK4, VORON, and AnkerMake M5C FDM 3D Printer. If your printer is from any other brand, please contact us to get the filament profile and technical support before use.
  • Please note: 1. The same color of PETG-CF has slightly different effects (Shiny or Matt) on different print models. 2. Different resolutions and devices may result in slightly different color displays!

• 【Unique silk luster】Models printed with TINMORRY Silk PLA 3D printing filaments have a silky luster and texture, and a smooth and delicate surface, which greatly improves the beauty and refinement of the model, making it very suitable for printing decorations, artworks, etc.
  • 【Usage Tips】1. Recommend printing temperature 195-225°C, build platform 50-60°C, printing speed: <100mm/s. 2. Please seal the filament after use to prevent moisture absorption. 3. Please secure the end of the filament after use to prevent tangling.
  • 【Good printability】TINMORRY PLA 3D printer filament is made of high-quality polylactic acid, with a low melting temperature, easy to use, low warping and shrinkage, and no odor during printing. Features superior surface finish and ultra-high dimensional accuracy.
  • 【Less Tangle & Eco-Friendly】 With a diameter of 1.75±0.03mm, TINMORRY Silk PLA filament is completely mechanically wound and strictly inspected manually to ensure clean winding and easy feeding. Made from renewable resources, our PLA 3D Printer Filament is eco-friendly 3D printing material.
  • 【Easy to use & New-user Friendly】 TINMORRY Silk PLA 3D printing filament is designed to be user-friendly and is an ideal choice for 3D printing beginners. It is compatible with most FDM 3D printers on the market and can achieve high-quality printing results without advanced printing settings.

title: 95A TPU 3D Printer Filament 1.75mm, 1 KG, Transparent Blue
body_html:
• Tips: 1.Since TPU 95A filament is highly sensitive to humidity, it is recommeded to dry before use(Blast Drying Oven: 70℃，8H) and keep sealed after use to achieve optimal printing performance. 2. Nozzle Temperature: 210-240℃, Bed Temperature: 30-50℃, Printing Speed ＜60mm/s. Printing and Keeping Container's Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with Desiccant)
  • High Elasticity & Toughness: With a Shore hardness of 95A±2 HA, this filament offers high elasticity and exceptional toughness. It is ideal for creating flexible and bendable prints that require movement, such as phone cases, flexible toys, prosthetics, and other parts that need to stretch or deform.
  • Premium Quality & Durable: TINMORRY TPU 3D printing filament is very easy to use and has excellent adhesion to the hot bed without warping. With consistent dimensional tolerances and smooth extrusion, you can achieve accurate and stable printing size. In addition, with good wear resistance, chemical resistance and UV resistance, our TPU 95A filament is very suitable for various applications, especially those exposed to outdoor or harsh conditions.
  • Vacuum Sealed Packaging: All filaments are completely dried for 24 hours before packaging and packed in sealed vacuum bags with desiccant, which can easily keep the TPU 3D printer filaments in the best storage condition and free from dust or moisture before opening the vacuum sealed package.
  • Wide Compatibility: With a diameter of 1.75 ±0.05mm, our TPU filament is compatible with a wide range of 3D printers, and in particular is perfectly compatible with Bambu FDM 3D printer (AMS not compatible). From customised footwear to medical devices, this 1.75mm TPU 3D printer filament can be flexibly used in a variety of fields.
